*Filed 13 Nov 2026 (CN-048). The owner-approved admin prototype v5 (`docs/demo/admin-proto-v5/`) becomes the real admin: mostly re-arranging screens to the prototype's menu and wiring the backend that is already built. Lumen stays the look. Backend that exists (courier booking and stickers, merge rules, incomplete-order capture, coupons, claims, size charts, exchanges, Customer 360, refunds and wallet, Calls to make, Rider issues, notices) is re-used. Full check: `docs/demo/admin-proto-v5/GAP-MAP.md`. Every new number or switch is a backend setting, off by default; every integration runs on a mock until the owner types the key.*
